title: A Leaky Day at Maple Court · 独立口语迁移
instructions: 先完成示范段的跟读诊断，再用不同人物、信息或立场录制自己的完整回答。示范与自由回答分别取证，服务未提供完整听音评阅时保持待评。
reference: Lin Wei lives in a small flat at Maple Court. It is on the second floor. There is a kitchen, a living room, one bedroom and a bathroom. There are two windows in the living room. The flat is old but quiet. Lin Wei likes it. On Monday morning, Lin Wei sees water under the kitchen sink. There is a lot of water on the floor. She puts a bowl under the sink. Then she calls the building office. A man answers the phone. "Good morning. Maple Court office. How can I help you?" Lin Wei says, "There is water under my sink. Can you send a plumber?" The man says, "Yes. Is there any water near the electric socket?" Lin Wei looks. "No, there isn't any water there. But there is some water near the fridge." The man says, "OK. Please don't use the kitchen. A plumber can come at 2 p. m." At 2 p. m.
